notes.title: GAME DOCS UPDATED
notes.notes:
The stand-alone docs installer has been updated, due to how WIN10 handles the start menu item entries.

[list]
[*]Go to Control Panel/Add Remove Programs, and uninstall the pre-existing game docs if you have it installed.
[*]Locate the AAW_STEAM_SHORTCUTS.EXE file located in the game's install folder and run it. See [url=http://www.3000ad.com/support/kb/index.php?action=article&id=39&relid=7]KB39[/url] for more info.
[/list]

notes.title: Game Docs
notes.notes:
The game has docs and commands built-in. You can access them using  ALT+D, ALT+Q

For printing, we also include the PDF versions. The Steam installer should do a silent install. If this fails for whatever reason (e.g. OS permissions), please follow this procedure to install them.

Look in the Steam's game install folder e.g.

[b]C:\Program Files (x86)\SteamLibrary\SteamApps\common\All Aspect Warfare\[/b]

There you will see [b]aaw_steam_shortcuts.exe[/b]

Please run that file to do a silent install of the docs and other resources (e.g. cheat codes!)

You can then locate this folder in [b]Start/3000AD/All Aspect Warfare Steam[/b]

notes.title: Steam Build v1.39 Update Coming Soon
notes.notes:
We haven't updated this game from v1.37 to v1.39 yet due to various revisions to the Steam backend which requires us to migrate to the latest. 

But even though v1.39 is not a major update, we are still looking into getting it migrated in the coming weeks. At which point we may also release the scripting system allowing you to create your own missions.

And in case you were wondering, these are the only things new in v1.39

[h1]1.00.39 | 11-09-10[/h1]

[list]
[*]Minor string localization corrections.
[/list]

[h1]1.00.38 | 03-23-10[/h1]

[list]
[*][MP]  Revised handling of stats server update
[*][MP]  FIXED: Joining a game from the GameLobby caused chat messages to be duplicated
[/list]
